title: Predicting the Empty Cells of Human Language Space: A Falsification-First Test of Typological Constraint and Unrealized Configurations
domain: linguistic typology / quantitative linguistics / language universals / predictive modeling
summary: A conceptual successor to ARIS4C002 that shifts from testing one global circular geometry to testing whether competing typological constraint models can predict held-out languages, masked feature bundles, and calibrated support over unobserved regions of language space. Extinct-language claims are tertiary and require independently documented historical holdouts.

lineage.boundary: 002 tests the simple global circular geometry; 017 tests predictive constraint structure over observed and unobserved typological configurations without assuming circularity.

aris.provenance: ARIS4C conceptual split from completed LING-01; falsification-first predictive-language-space design scaffold

outputs.exception: Pre-pilot concept scaffold; final-output visual requirements are not yet applicable.
